blocks.text: I can’t recommend a complete award journey from this evidence: the award results are partial leads rather than verified, bookable end-to-end itineraries. They lack flight schedules and confirmed connections, so they cannot establish arrival times or whether segments work together. The cash search does provide a useful separate reference for SFO–Bangkok on January 1, but it is not an award option.
This is the requested-route cash baseline, not an award itinerary.

For January 1, the incomplete SFO–Bangkok award leads include United economy at 60,500 miles and Alaska economy at 42,500 miles. These are program-specific quotes, not verified whole-trip prices; cash amounts and price scope are unknown, and neither lead supplies a schedule or stops. The search also found Taiwan connections as possible leads, but those require reaching Taipei separately or arranging an additional connection. The SFO–Taipei and Taipei–Bangkok observations do not establish a complete SFO–Bangkok itinerary, and no protected connection is confirmed. The Taiwan search was partial, and the direct-route award detail search was omitted; availability and the leads themselves were observed on October 9, 2026, not in real time.
